# Patching_Steps

__Please follow the below mentioned steps to ensure that your VM’s are automatically patched through Azure Update Manager:__

__Apply the below mentioned polices :__

1. __Tag all virtual machines with Patch=True tag__

This policy ensures that all the machines deployed in the subscription are with tagged with the value Patch=True

__Tag all virtual machines deployed for inclusion in scope of recurring update via Azure Update Manager service__

Below is the policy definition for the same:

![](data:image/x-emf;base64,)

1. __Set the patch orchestration mode to Customer Managed Schedules for the Linux virtual machines\.__

This policy ensures that the patch orchestration mode on the Linux virtual machines is set to Customer Managed Schedules:

__\[tcx\] Configure Linux virtual machines for recurring updates via AUM through customer defined windows\.__

![](data:image/x-emf;base64,)

1. __Set the Patch orchestration mode to Customer Managed Schedules for the Windows virtual machines\.__

This policy ensures that the patch orchestration mode on the Linux virtual machines is set to Customer Managed Schedules:

__\[tcx\] Configure windows virtual machines for recurring updates via AUM through customer defined windows\.__

![](data:image/x-emf;base64,)

__Configure Maintenance Configuration Windows:__

The maintenance configuration window  is configured to create specific user\-defined windows which would be leveraged by the Azure Update Manager to update the machines with the resp patches configured\.

__As per the current configuration in Non\-Prod, we are having 2 maintenance configuration windows which are updating Linux and Windows machines respectively \.They are each running on Saturday’s and Sundays respectively at 5 pm IST\.__

__Steps to configure Maintenance Configuration:__

1. Go to Azure Portal – Maintenance Configuration\.

![A screenshot of a computer

AI-generated content may be incorrect.](data:image/png;base64,)

You have to place the maintenance configuration within a particular Subscription and a resource group \.

1. Create a schedule

![A screenshot of a computer

AI-generated content may be incorrect.](data:image/png;base64,)

Add the start date , time and the duration of the maintenance configuration for which you want  the update to run\. 

1. Once done , Click on Next to go to Dynamic Scopes\. Click on Add a Dynamic Scope\.

![A screenshot of a computer

AI-generated content may be incorrect.](data:image/png;base64,)

Select all the subscriptions that you want to include\. In case of all the subscriptions, click on Select all\. This would filter out machines from all the subscriptions applicable that are matching the filter criteria\.

1. Click on Filter By – Select\.

![A screenshot of a message

AI-generated content may be incorrect.](data:image/png;base64,)

1. In the filter criteria, mention the required details like Machine Resource Type, OS  type etc whatever you want to configure for your window\.

![A screenshot of a computer

AI-generated content may be incorrect.](data:image/png;base64,)

1. In the tags section, select Any and the Name Value pair as Patch=True

![A screenshot of a computer

AI-generated content may be incorrect.](data:image/png;base64,) 

1. Click on OK and Save the Maintenance Configuration\.

![A screenshot of a chat

AI-generated content may be incorrect.](data:image/png;base64,)

Your machines are now ready to be updated by AUM through the maintenance configuration windows\.

__*12\] Give the parameters and query to get the report *__

We have 3 scenarios

a\. *The sample query to get list of all the machines which *__*succeeded*__* in patch installation:*

arg\(''\)\.patchinstallationresources  
| where type in~ \("microsoft\.compute/virtualmachines/patchinstallationresults", "microsoft\.hybridcompute/machines/patchinstallationresults"\)  
| where properties\.status =~ "Succeeded" // "CompletedWithWarnings" and other statuses can also be considered  
| where properties\.lastModifiedDateTime > ago\(6d\)  
| extend machineName = tostring\(split\(id, '/', 8\)\)  
| where properties\.maintenanceRunId contains "tcxonazure\_linuxweeklypatching"  
| parse id with vmResourceId "/patchInstallationResults" \*  
| parse machineName with VM\_name  
| parse subscriptionId with Subscription  
| parse properties\.status with vmStatus  
| parse resourceGroup with resourcegroup  
| parse properties\.lastModifiedDateTime with Date\_and\_Time  
| project VM\_name, vmStatus, Date\_and\_Time, resourcegroup, Subscription  
| distinct VM\_name, vmStatus, Date\_and\_Time, resourcegroup, Subscription

b\. *The sample query to get list of all the machines which *__*failed*__* in patch installation:*

arg\(''\)\.patchinstallationresources  
| where type in~ \("microsoft\.compute/virtualmachines/patchinstallationresults", "microsoft\.hybridcompute/machines/patchinstallationresults"\)  
| where properties\.status =~ "Failed" // "CompletedWithWarnings" and other statuses can also be considered  
| where properties\.lastModifiedDateTime > ago\(6d\)  
| extend machineName = tostring\(split\(id, '/', 8\)\)  
| where properties\.maintenanceRunId contains "tcxonazure\_linuxweeklypatching"  
| parse id with vmResourceId "/patchInstallationResults" \*  
| parse machineName with VM\_name  
| parse subscriptionId with Subscription  
| parse properties\.status with vmStatus  
| parse resourceGroup with resourcegroup  
| parse properties\.lastModifiedDateTime with Date\_and\_Time  
| project VM\_name, vmStatus, Date\_and\_Time, resourcegroup, Subscription  
| distinct VM\_name, vmStatus, Date\_and\_Time, resourcegroup, Subscription

c\. *The sample query to get list of all the machines which were *__*excluded *__*in patch installation:*

arg\(''\)\.resources  
| where type == "microsoft\.compute/virtualmachines"  
| where tags\.Patch =~ "False"   
| where properties\.storageProfile\.osDisk\.osType =~ 'Linux'  
| parse name with VM\_Name

| parse subscriptionId with Subscription  
| parse tags with Tags  
| parse resourceGroup with Resource\_group  
| project VM\_Name ,Subscription, Tags , Resource\_group
